comment: Redaction cases both sides must agree on. The exporter side is tools/tos_cp3/redact.py (tests/tools/test_cp3_redact.py); the reader side is services/dashboard/routes/_redact.py (tests/unit/dashboard/test_tos_status.py). They cannot share code — services/ may not import tools/, the dashboard image does not carry tools/ at all — so each states the rule itself and both assert this file. The `redacted` cases are the shapes that have actually appeared or can appear: runner `die` messages interpolating $TENANT_CUSTODY_ROOT/$TENANT_LOG/$DATA_LEAF, `f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"` from a leaf or calendar open, and account numbers. The `kept` cases are the ones a careless rule breaks: Korean text containing a slash, ratios, session names and trading dates whose digit runs are shorter than an account's. Placeholders: PATH = «<경로>», ACCOUNT = «<계좌>».

redacted.why: runner die: a log path at the end of a sentence
redacted.input: band process exited rc 1 (gate refusal) — see /home/deploy/.local/state/tos/cp3-long.log
redacted.expected: band process exited rc 1 (gate refusal) — see <경로>

redacted.expected: FileNotFoundError: [Errno 2] No such file or directory: '<경로>'

kept.why: a resident paper session directory name
a KRW figure is far short of an account's digits
a ratio whose slash follows a space is still a ratio

a Korean word, a slash and an English word is not a path
a bare eight-digit run is a trading date, not an account
